title: Tech Note: Application Signing with 4D
author: Timothy Aaron Penner, Senior Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: Application/code signing on macOS and Windows is still a fundamental, current requirement for distributing 4D-built applications, and 4D's BUILD APPLICATION signing integration continues to exist, but the specific tooling details here (older signtool/Windows SDK versions, older macOS notarization-less codesign flow) are dated given Apple's introduction of mandatory notarization and Microsoft's evolving certificate/EV requirements since 2018.
related_updates: Apple has since made notarization (not just signing) mandatory for smooth Gatekeeper execution on macOS, which this 2018 note does not cover
Windows code-signing certificate requirements have tightened (EV certificates increasingly required/recommended for reputation with SmartScreen), beyond the self-signed-certificate demo shown here
the basic 4D BUILD APPLICATION signing hook and signtool/codesign mechanics remain conceptually valid starting points
